name: my-flux
description: MY FLUX - Sistema Integrado de Gestao Operacional de Pessoas.

scripts.deploy:build: pnpm --filter @my-flux/shared --filter @my-flux/types --filter @my-flux/validation --filter @my-flux/config build && pnpm --filter @my-flux/api db:generate && VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api/v1 pnpm --filter @my-flux/web build && pnpm --filter @my-flux/api bundle
scripts.deploy:start: pnpm --filter @my-flux/api exec prisma migrate deploy && node apps/api/dist/server.js
scripts.start: cd apps/api && ./node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate deploy && node dist/server.js
